finding.title: Prose rendering ignores tabs and span styles
finding.message: In prose mode the rendering replaces the row's rich text with plain text styled only by `sty`, discarding per-span styling. In addition, wrapped-row geometry uses tab handling that is skipped in prose mode, so tabs in a proportional editor render with default glyph widths.
finding.suggestion: Handle tab characters explicitly in prose mode, e.g. expand them to spaces or pass a tab width to the shaper, and add a test with tabs.

finding.title: Full relayout shaping under buffer lock on each width change
finding.message: Each source line is shaped through WrapLines while the buffer lock is held, and SetProseWrap re-lays out all lines on every key change (every width change during a live resize). For large documents this makes layout O(document) shaping work under a lock, and resizing can stall the UI.
finding.suggestion: Cache wrap results per line keyed by the text and width, and debounce or defer relayout during interactive resize.
finding.evidence: shaped := sh.WrapLines(rich.NewText(sty, txt), sty, &style, math32.Vec2(width, float32(len(txt)+1)*max(float32(16), style.LineHeightDots(sty))))
